description: Screenshot of Q post No.10596922 on 8kun, dated 09/10/20 (Thu) 21:03:19, tripcode !!Hs1Jq13jV6, ID 5d07c9, followed by roughly 70 reply links. The post lists three numbered predictions about the upcoming presidential debates: that the 'Biden camp' will find an excuse to terminate, will be given the questions ahead of time, or will be given the questions plus assistance via a 'special communication device'. These are the drop's claims, presented without evidence.
flags: Unverified claims: the drop's debate predictions are assertions without evidence

description: Three-panel photo collage of Joe Biden. Left: a large profile photograph of Biden speaking in a dark suit before a blue star-patterned backdrop. Top right: a video still of Biden in a navy suit and blue patterned tie with his hand over his chest in front of a CNN backdrop. Bottom right: an extreme, blurry close-up of the side of his head focused on his ear — a framing used in Q-adjacent posts to suggest he wears an earpiece or communication device, though the image itself shows only an ear.
flags: The ear close-up implies an earpiece/communication-device claim that the image does not substantiate

description: Mobile browser screenshot of a press update on nrcc.org, the National Republican Congressional Committee site, headlined 'Tom Malinowski lobbied to protect sexual predators', bylined Michael McAdams, August 6, 2020, over a Capitol-dome banner. The visible body text asserts that while a DC lobbyist Malinowski worked to keep sex offenders who violated children off a national registry and pushed for more lenient sentences; part of the paragraph is highlighted. These are the NRCC's partisan claims about the congressman, presented here as the page states them.
text: AA. nrcc.org. NRCC. PRESS UPDATE. < Back to Press Updates. Tom Malinowski lobbied to protect sexual predators. MICHAEL MCADAMS | AUGUST 6, 2020. That headline is not a mistake. description: Annotated collage built around a photograph of Hillary Clinton wearing headphones at a microphone in a home library, apparently recording a podcast. The annotator outlines a book spine reading 'LUCIO BUBACCO' in the stack beside her laptop and adds insets: the cover of the Arnoldsche art book 'Lucio Bubacco: erotics', an 'ABOUT' text block describing the Murano glass artist's erotic, Mephistophelian glasswork, and photos of several of his demon-themed glass sculptures. The collage insinuates significance in the book's presence in Clinton's study; the photo itself shows only a bookshelf and podcast setup.

ABOUT. • Lucio Bubacco's works in glass are unparalleled examples of extraordinary Venetian flame technique • A witty play with the borders of kitsch, and biblical and carnevalesque iconography • Masterful glass art from Murano Most of the subjects of Lucio Bubacco's (b. 1957) glass art are provocative and polarizing; at the same time they are sensual and beguiling. In a kind of erotic 'trance dance' - Mephistophelian and frequently riotous - nightmarish fabulous creatures and mythological phantasms virtually undulate about each other. His technical virtuosity in creative execution is unparalleled, for the Murano-born glass artist has elevated the Venetian flame technique to a new level of skill and complexity. Bubacco has captured human feelings and emotions in the masterly play of gestures and muscles of the glass figures featured in his burlesque installations. Full of wit and irony he thus explores the limits of kitsch without overstepping them. Follow him into a world of carnavalesque orgies, crystalline incubi and erotic fantasies in glass!
flags: Insinuation collage: implies hidden meaning in a book visible on Clinton's shelf; the photograph itself substantiates only the book's presence
